title: schc_session: bounded context + tombstone + admission-floor tables
description:
Parent project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.3.7.6 (spec/03-adaptation.md 5.6, authenticated bounded Zephyr SCHC session authority). Decomposed per Yegge's rule; this is one independently landable slice. Zephyr C in lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/ + host tests in lichen/tests/. Run host CMake tests on this Linux host (Attic toolchain absent; use local gcc/clang + cmake, ASan+UBSan per tests/cmake/test_common.cmake).

SLICE 2 (state containers, depends on slice 1 identity types): bounded, no-hot-path-allocation storage for fragmentation session state. Reassembly context key = ordered tuple (local_identity, remote_signer_identity, remote_key_generation, fragmentation_rule_id) per spec 5.6. Bounds: <=4 contexts per remote signer, <=64 global context entries; tombstones + admission floors + hold-down records bounded to <=256 entries per direction, evict oldest tombstone by terminal-time on overflow. Static/fixed storage only (no malloc in hot path). Implement table alloc/lookup/invalidate with the generation token carried on every entry; unit tests for the bound ceilings, per-signer cap, global cap, tombstone overflow eviction order, and that allocation exhaustion does NOT evict/mutate an active authenticated context. LAND AFTER slice 1; slices 3-5 consume this.
close_reason: Implemented the bounded SCHC session state tables (spec/03-adaptation.md 5.6). New module schc_session_table.{c,h}: reassembly ctx key = ordered tuple (local, remote_signer, remote_key_generation, rule_id); bounds 4 ctx/remote-signer, 64 global ctx, 256 tombstones/direction (evict-oldest-by-terminal_time on overflow), 256 floors/direction (evict smallest high_water, fail-closed); static fixed storage, no hot-path malloc. ctx_alloc idempotent on exact duplicate, fails WITHOUT evicting/mutating an active context on exhaustion (-ENOBUFS global / -EAGAIN per-signer). floor monotonic (never lowered). invalidate_generation atomically retires ctx+tombstone+floor for (remote,generation), isolating same-key reinstall. Wired into Zephyr build. Tests: lichen/tests/schc_session_table (host CMake, UBSan), 14/14 PASS covering bounds, per-signer cap + other-signer isolation, global cap no-evict, tombstone/floor overflow eviction order, monotonic high_water AND terminal_time, atomic invalidation, same-key reinstall isolation, NULL rejection. 3x codereview (kimi-k3, opencode run): correctness PASS after fixing floor-eviction doc/code mismatch + adding floor-overflow test; security PASS after fixing non-monotonic tombstone high_water (replay-regression P2); edge-cases PASS after fixing non-monotonic tombstone terminal_time (P3); re-review converged PASS. Slice .3 next.
